channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 03
item.description:
53 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed shore ice spawning over railway tracks by preventing ice placement on rails.
  • Fixed roadside waterpipes spawning on top of roads at T‑junctions by excluding road topology.
  • Added a combat log entry when hitting gull groups, giving players feedback on those attacks.
  • Fixed a potential null‑reference crash when accessing NetRead position data, improving connection stability.

World & Environment

  • Fixed shore ice spawning over railway tracks by preventing ice placement on rails.
  • Fixed roadside waterpipes spawning on top of roads at T‑junctions by excluding road topology.

Combat

  • Added a combat log entry when hitting gull groups, giving players feedback on those attacks.
  • Extended triangular prism splash damage bounds to include grills and triangle hatches, slightly adjusting hatch bounds.

Inventory

  • Fixed a crash that occurred when opening the inventory during a phone conversation.
  • Fixed incorrect information shown in new phone conversations after server commands were used.
  • Fixed the drop-item keybind so it now drops the intended item instead of the held belt item while the inventory is open.

Weapons & Turrets

  • Ensured turrets always use the stock's extended properties, making turret behavior consistent regardless of stock configuration.

Vehicles

  • Fixed a crash after rejoining a server that caused lingering wake effects from destroyed boats.

World & Monuments

  • Bunker entrance size and fade have been tightened to match the monument footprint, improving entry alignment and removing out‑of‑bounds paint data.
  • Radiation Town radius and blend have been slightly reduced and smoothed, preventing the effect from spilling beyond its intended area.
  • Jungle Ruins D monument tile and terrain map sizes were reduced, eliminating radius overhang and unused splat areas for cleaner boundaries.

Stability

  • Fixed a potential null‑reference crash when accessing NetRead position data, improving connection stability.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Adjusted flock audio distance, extending the range at which players can hear bird flocks and improving situational awareness.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 02
item.description:
91 development commits

Transport

  • Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
  • Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.

Combat

  • PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
  • UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

AI & Wildlife

  • Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
  • New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.

Audio & Effects

  • Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.

Stability

  • Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 01
item.description:
3 development commits

World Generation

  • Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

Animals & AI

  • Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
